scope: Native visual review of four W01 idle/walk atlases against each other and the current immutable W01 run artwork; no raster changes, runtime installation or build performed by reviewer.
result: accepted for calibrated runtime verification; no mandatory native-image rejection
calibrationStatus: UPP, translated body anchors, in-game size and transition continuity require the separate calibration and after-capture review; this native art review does not certify them.
observations: Explore idle/walk use the current running character's broad side-parted short silver waves, angular face and jaw, short neck and compatible head-to-shoulder relationship, replacing the previous tight curls and narrow idle face.

The four new sheets share the slender burgundy-and-gold garment silhouette, higher-looking hip/leg relationship, straight grey trousers, brown laced boots and side leather pouch. These are visually compatible with current run; no physical centimetre or exact head-count measurements are claimed.
Explore sheets show the stowed sword with a gold round pommel. Held sheets show the drawn blade and grip with empty back scabbard openings; no duplicate stowed gold sword pommel was observed.

Held idle/walk preserve the approved explore head, clothing and leg identity. Changes are concentrated in the sword, scabbard occupancy and gripping arm. Held idle front body is translated horizontally relative to explore, which requires corresponding origin translation rather than reuse of old atlas coordinates.

Explore walk front phases 0 and 2 visibly distinguish the opposite advancing leg and arm arrangement. Side-view 0/2 silhouettes are similar because the costume and limbs are largely symmetric; static similarity alone is not evidence of a repeated same-side gait.
acceptedLimitedDifferences: Fine gold embroidery, small hair highlights and individual curl placement differ slightly between drawings.
The standing crown waves look a little more orderly than running; the same broad short-wave identity remains legible.
Straight standing posture appears narrower and more elongated than running with bent legs and torso lean. Native pixels alone do not establish equal game-world height.
Hand grip, arm swing and small garment folds change with holding the drawn sword.
remainingVerification: Verify the separate explicit UPP and per-frame foot anchors, including held idle front body translation.
Inspect four-phase slow-walk playback and idle/walk/run transitions in the after capture for foot contact, smooth opposing half-cycles, scale and ground registration.
